message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Sire (seniorestibancreations@gmail.com; GitHub/Vercel org `estibancreations-svg`) wants to: load Book One of the "Crossroads of Identity" series (manuscript + character images + scene art) into VisionWeaver and have VisionWeaver create clips → videos → movies from it; see everything VisionWeaver creates inside their own dashboard (not only in Runway); and make the VisionWeaver dashboard look and work like the Higgsfield repo they uploaded. They asked me to review the whole system, explain why it does/doesn't do these things, then fix what is wrong and tell them how and what.
   Follow-up: user supplied the Book One manuscript (Google Doc link, actually a .docx in Drive, id 1BLnGC44fUNGxpcljsdXw5Xg1pBc8hnBh) and 11 images (7 book covers = accurate character/look reference; 4 portrait photos = backup). Decisions given via AskUserQuestion: (a) ship "Straight to production"; (b) character naming: "I guess from covers, you confirm"; (c) test render: "Also render one 10-second test clip" (spend some Runway credits).
   Standing user preferences: start with what was understood; use analogies; 6th-grade US reading level; carefully considered answers; factual data with APA citations; Wikipedia only as direction and must be disclosed (none used); voice response only when they say "tell me"/"read to me"/"explain out loud". Memory preference: count/confirm figures rather than repeating stated numbers.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - VisionWeaver is a workspace inside MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD (Vite + React + TypeScript on Vercel, Supabase backend), not a standalone app.
   - Supabase project "Master Dashboard" (id yqealeekngxooyoemfba): tables vw_projects, vw_generations, vw_assets, vw_scenes, vw_characters, vw_renders, reference_assets, production_jobs/scenes; storage buckets `visionweaver-outputs` (private, 100MB, mime allowlist: png/jpeg/webp/mp4/mp3/wav/markdown/json) and `reference-images` (public); edge function `visionweaver-studio` (Deno; actions create/refresh/retry/list/tick + GET /health; providers Runway, Kling, ElevenLabs, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6, Higgsfield in repo only).
   - Runway dev API (`https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1`, version 2024-11-06): text_to_image with gen4_image_turbo requires ≥1 referenceImages; text_to_video (gen4.5 ≤10s, seedance2_5 up to 30s), video_to_video extend for continuity; multi-shot parent/child generations (`operation: multi_shot_video`, children linked by `parent_generation_id`, `sequence_index`), `mirrorOutputs` copies results into the private bucket; signed URLs (3600s) for playback.
   - `api/visionweaver-assemble.js`: Vercel serverless ffmpeg stream-copy concat of completed child segments into a master mp4 (only for parents with provider 'visionweaver' & operation 'multi_shot_video'); no UI button yet.
   - Auth: production requires Supabase magic-link sign-in; builder mode only in DEV. Edge `currentUser` needs active ceo_organization_memberships role architect/ceo/operator.
   - RLS: storage allows authenticated users to SELECT/INSERT only under `{auth.uid()}/…` folder of visionweaver-outputs (no UPDATE/DELETE → avoid upsert client-side); vw_assets/vw_generations/vw_projects have owner_id policies; vw_characters/vw_scenes/vw_renders and one vw_projects policy require JWT app_metadata role ceo/architect; reference_assets has permissive "true" policy (avoid).
   - Constraints: vw_assets.kind ∈ {image, video, audio, document, book, movie}; vw_scenes UNIQUE(project_id, scene_no); vw_characters UNIQUE(universe, name).
   - Sandbox limits: github.com blocked by egress policy (do not bypass); use GitHub MCP tools for read/push; Supabase MCP for SQL/migrations/edge deploy; Vercel MCP for deployments/build logs; Google Drive MCP for manuscript.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD/src/components/VisionWeaverWorkspace.tsx` (43KB, viewed fully; no local copy on disk — inline only)
     - Central file to rewrite. Key facts: `handleFiles` builds local Asset objects with `URL.createObjectURL` only; `characters` are local state seeded with one "Evelyn Reed"; `load()` reads `production_jobs`/`production_scenes` (empty) in non-builder mode; `generate()` calls `supabase.functions.invoke('visionweaver-studio', {body:{action:'create', media_type, prompt, title, organization_id, parameters:{ratio, quality, duration, target_duration_seconds, continuity_mode, video_generation_profile, provider_shot_max_seconds, variant_count, platform}}})` when signed in, else makes only a local plan; `loadLive(refresh)` invokes action 'refresh'/'list' every 15s; Library view renders `liveGenerations` (video/image/audio playable_urls, retry, download package) + local reference assets; nav array: Home, Agent, Studio, Apps, Workflows, Characters, Library, Academy; modes video/image/audio/movie/book. No assemble button. Uses `useIdentity()` (isBuilder, user, organizationId) and `health` from `${VITE_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/visionweaver-studio/health`.
   - `MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD/src/App.tsx`, `src/components/AuthGate.tsx`, `src/auth/IdentityContext.tsx` (read): route surface 'vision' renders `<VisionWeaverWorkspace/>`; BUILDER_MODE only in DEV.
   - `MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD/supabase/functions/visionweaver-studio/index.ts` (repo main, 56,444 chars, 1110 lines; saved at `/tmp/vw/repo_studio.ts`; deployed v23 copy at `/tmp/vw_studio.ts`, 1019 lines, no Higgsfield). Diff = repo adds `import { createHiggsfieldAdapter } from '../visionweaver-orchestrator/higgsfield-adapter.js'`, `higgsfieldClient()`, health verification, routing after Kling, submit/poll branches. Problem line (both versions): image branch of submitGeneration:
     ```ts
     path = '/text_to_image';
     payload = { model: await setting('runway_image_model', 'gen4_image_turbo'), promptText: generation.prompt.slice(0, 1000), ratio: parameters.ratio || '1360:768', referenceImages: [] };
     ```
     Other key spots: `cors()` (allows master-ceo-dashboard*.vercel.app), `secret()`/`setting()`, `routeFor(mediaType, parameters)`, `createProject(user, body)` (inserts vw_projects, then multi-shot parent+children generations and vw_scenes shot ledger, calls `tick`), `extendSource`, `mirrorOutputs`, `listWorkspace(user)` (returns projects, generations w/ children+progress+playable_urls, assets w/ playable_url), Deno.serve handler (health version: 6).
   - `MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD/supabase/functions/visionweaver-orchestrator/higgsfield-adapter.js` (read fully; small): `createHiggsfieldAdapter({apiKey, apiSecret, baseUrl})` with `submitRenderJob` and `pollRenderJob`; plan is to bundle it as `higgsfield-adapter.js` in the edge deploy with import path `./higgsfield-adapter.js`.
   - `MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD/api/visionweaver-assemble.js` (read fully): POST with Bearer token and `generation_id`; requires parent status complete and children with storage_paths; writes master to `{user}/{project}/masters/…mp4`, updates vw_generations.result.assembly, inserts vw_assets 'VisionWeaver assembled master'; returns signed `master_url`. Plan: extend to accept multiple generation ids for whole-movie stitching (phase 2).
   - `Higgsfield-Integration-Layer` (api/routes: credits-management, generate-image, generate-video, manage-jobs, media-library; schemas; workflows; docs) — backend-only, no UI.
   - `Crossroads-of-Identity` repo (00-series-bible, 01-book-1-convergence … 07-book-7-evolution, 08-characters, 09-world-locations, 10-film-series-adaptation, 11-artwork-storyboards, 12-source-research-memory, 99-archive).
   - `/tmp/vw/book1_raw.txt`: extracted Book One text (642,415 chars; 88,863 words; 4,455 lines). Chapter headings in body only at lines 46 (Ch1 The News, Marcus), 258 (Ch2 The Call, Jordan), 496 (Ch3 The Return, Desiree), 816/818 (Ch4 "The Lawyer", Marcus). TOC: 15 chapters (POV rotating Marcus/Jordan/Desiree; Ch15 alternating) + Epilogue: The Letters. Ending scene shows Desiree painting; fourth inheritor Victor present.
   - Uploaded images in `/root/.claude/uploads/f6c49162-7b81-5373-a7c1-f58edfefee41/` (order: curly-haired woman green dress; woman red denim jacket; woman yellow kimono/bob; man orange jacket; covers Expansion (4), Transformation (6), Evolution (7), Revelations (3), Foundations (2), Convergence (1), Legacy (5); then repeats). Covers have title text — plan to crop faces before using as Runway references.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - SQL error `COALESCE types text[] and jsonb cannot be matched` (output_urls/storage_paths are text[]): fixed by using `cardinality(output_urls)` / `cardinality(storage_paths)`.
   - `jsonb_typeof(text[])` error: same fix (cardinality).
   - `git clone` of MASTER_CEO_DASHBOARD failed (no credentials, then 403 "no rule allows host github.com" egress block): not to be bypassed; use GitHub MCP tools instead.
   - WebFetch of Runway API docs returned only navigation (no param details): still need another way to confirm Runway model/param requirements (or design fallbacks).
   - MCP servers briefly disconnected/reconnected mid-session; re-loaded tools via ToolSearch.
   - Root causes identified in system (not yet fixed): empty `referenceImages` → Runway 400; uploads never sent; characters not persisted; no book intake; no assemble UI; Higgsfield code undeployed.

5. Problem Solving:
   Diagnosed the seven problems (see analysis) and reported them plainly. Verified via SQL that outputs do save (11 complete generations, 6 stored assets) and via live health that providers are verified, so failures are wiring/UI, not credentials. Ruled out CORS and builder-mode as causes. Decided implementation approach (branch → Vercel build check → merge to main; additive DB migration; edge function deploy via MCP with inlined adapter path). Ongoing: designing exact migration, edge actions, and UI rewrite; have not modified any live system yet.

6. All user messages:
   - Message 1: "I want to upload Book one - Crossroads Of Identity into my system VisionWeaver as a .md or what ever, upload the images of the characters and some scene work i have created and from there i want visionweaver to create the clips and videos and then movies from that. * Thesystem exist. When it creates something there is no output place for me to work with what it created unless i look into Runway and i want it to show in my system * I also uploaded into GitHub Higgsfield in the repositories and wanted my dashboard to look and work similar to that and it doesn't. Neither. * review the system and see if it can and does it directly - why does it or doesn't do that. …you also can see how the system runs now. Review it and everything in it and then fix what is wrong and tell me how and what."
   - Message 2: [11 images attached: book covers 1–7 and portrait photos] plus link https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BLnGC44fUNGxpcljsdXw5Xg1pBc8hnBh/edit?usp=drivesdk&ouid=107612620046354782387&rtpof=true&sd=true and text: "Here is the file for it, and I'm attaching the images but they will be in the Google Drive as well. I uploaded the cover art of the books so you can see them and some of the changes in the characters. The book covers are accurate and the photography is backup in case someone is missing."
   - AskUserQuestion answers (user-role): shipping = "Straight to production"; characters = "I guess from covers, you confirm (Recommended)"; test render = "Also render one 10-second test clip".
   - (Latest turn is the system-level request to produce this summary; no additional user instruction.)

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Apply additive Supabase migration (character/reference/chapter storage support; owner policies) on project yqealeekngxooyoemfba.
   - Modify and deploy the edge function `visionweaver-studio` (based on repo main + Higgsfield adapter bundled as `./higgsfield-adapter.js`, verify_jwt false): reference-image support (fix `referenceImages: []` 400), image-to-video with character references, book import/chapter split, character save/list, extended list returning characters/books/chapters, backward compatible.
   - Rewrite `VisionWeaverWorkspace.tsx` (and any new components): real uploads to `visionweaver-outputs/{uid}/…` registered as vw_assets, persisted characters, Books/intake view, unified Library (including import of Runway-made files by upload), chapter → clip generation, Assemble master button calling `/api/visionweaver-assemble`; push via GitHub MCP to a branch, check Vercel build, merge to main (user chose straight to production).
   - Prepare Book One chapter-split .md (add missing chapter breaks 5–15 + Epilogue; note Chapter 4 title mismatch and Victor) and a story bible with character-to-image mapping for the user to confirm (inferred: cover-1 man in suit ≈ Marcus, purple-bob woman in leather jacket ≈ Jordan, woman with locs ≈ Desiree; Victor and the 4 portrait photos unnamed); crop faces from covers for references.
   - Render one ~10-second test clip from Chapter 1 (user approved credit spend) and prove it appears in the Library.
   - Verify (build passes, outputs visible), then report in 6th-grade language with analogies and APA sources; phase 2 items (whole-movie stitching across chapters, Higgsfield keys) to mention.
   - Task list: #3 in_progress, #4 pending (verification/report).

8. Current Work:
   Immediately before the summary request I was in the planning/pre-build phase of the fix (task #3). I had just queried Supabase for constraints and column definitions of vw_assets, vw_projects, vw_scenes, vw_characters, vw_generations (results captured above) to design an additive migration and decide where to store references, characters and chapters (vw_assets for references with metadata.role; vw_scenes rows with spec.kind='chapter' for book chapters; vw_characters needs owner/project columns or edge-function service-key writes). I had loaded the tools for deploy_edge_function, apply_migration, push_files, create_or_update_file, list_project_domains, get_deployment, list_deployment_events, and get_runtime_logs. No production changes had been made yet.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Continue the build as the user approved ("Straight to production" with a test clip): write and apply the additive Supabase migration for characters/references/chapters, then modify the edge function (start from `/tmp/vw/repo_studio.ts`, fix the `referenceImages: []` image branch by resolving reference asset signed URLs, add import_book/character actions, extend `listWorkspace`), deploy it via `mcp__Supabase__deploy_edge_function` with the Higgsfield adapter bundled, th
